scope: 25 CASH and 10 SPINS canonical training-game artworks
reviewMethod: Every final 640x360 optimized asset opened individually with view_image. Original imagegen inputs for the three clean-plate edits were also inspected at full size. Checks cover game meaning, scene/camera variety, large mobile-readable focus, no repeated template, and no visible generated playing cards or text. Native-card overlay geometry is inferred from source pixels and the component dimensions; root performs hosted UI checks.

summary.hostedNativeOverlayFitReview: Root-owned follow-up; per-scene fit notes below.
